title: Scheduled successes precede a failed push install
root_cause: The push job fails during dependency installation because the requested contour-graph version has no matching distribution. The earlier successful runs used the schedule event, so they do not provide a comparable baseline for assigning a change as the culprit.

relevant_evidence.why: pip reports that the pinned version cannot be resolved and the install step exits unsuccessfully.
The requirements file pins the unavailable version.
